title: Desk Lamp
description: Simple desk lamp stands beside the Commodore monitor.
details:
The lamp has a simple metal frame and adjustable joints. Most evenings it throws a focused pool of warm light across the keyboard, floppy disks, tangled cables, and half-finished notes covering the desk. 
Together with the glow of the CRT monitor, it gives the workspace the atmosphere of a tiny late-night laboratory assembled from electronics, caffeine, and questionable sleep habits.
takeFailure: The lamp already has a job. It spends most nights helping you navigate bad code, bad ideas, and bad lighting. You decide to let it keep doing that.
